races.paceDynamic: Lumenbourg will take the field along from the front with Bay Breeze and Andalprofit tracking prominently, creating a sustainable but steady gallop in these testing soft conditions. The pace won't be fierce with only one confirmed leader, allowing the trio of hold-up horses - Groundsman, Jet Warrior and Amaysmont - to get into contention from off the pace. With the soft ground favouring stamina over speed and no early pressure on Lumenbourg, this race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish with late runs when the pace steadies.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady and the soft ground takes its toll on the early leaders
scenarios.body: Lumenbourg sets uncontested fractions but fades in the final furlong, allowing the closers to sweep past with fresher legs. Groundsman, Jet Warrior and Amaysmont benefit from the tactical setup and testing conditions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent racers hang on
scenarios.trigger: If Bay Breeze or Andalprofit can improve their position tracking Lumenbourg without over-racing
scenarios.body: The soft ground suits Bay Breeze's previous course winner profile, while the steady pace allows prominent racers to conserve energy for a sustained finish. Hold-up horses find too much to do despite the tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner stays strong
scenarios.trigger: If Lumenbourg gets easy lead fractions and finds extra stamina reserves in the testing ground
scenarios.body: The leader dictates throughout and kicks clear when the field comes under pressure, with soft conditions playing to staying power rather than finishing speed. Late runners struggle to make up the ground despite tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If the soft ground and steady early pace creates a sprint finish from the 2f pole
scenarios.body: All runners bunch up turning for home making it a lottery finish where any running style can prevail. The race becomes more about individual horse ability than tactical positioning.

races.paceDynamic: Sodeto looks the most obvious pace angle as a confirmed front runner, though he faded badly on debut and carries the warning flags of a horse who may not sustain his effort. Glory Road, Pepsea, Affettuoso and Ceinture d'Orion all show prominent tendencies which should create a competitive early gallop over this 1m1f trip on testing ground. The combination of multiple prominent runners and soft going will likely create a searching pace that turns this into a stamina test in the final three furlongs. This race shape strongly favours horses with proven hold-up tactics who can finish strongly when the early pace collapses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group (Sodeto, Glory Road, Pepsea, Affettuoso) all commit early and the soft ground takes its toll
scenarios.body: The pace will be unsustainable and those who race prominently will fade badly in the final furlong. Hold-up horses with stamina reserves will sweep past the tiring leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Suits Classier
scenarios.trigger: If Glory Road or Affettuoso can dictate a more sensible tempo from prominent positions
scenarios.body: The higher-rated horses with class can control the race from the front and kick clear when it matters. Their superior ability will tell over this demanding trip on soft ground.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Weak Pace Favours Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Sodeto sets uncontested fractions and the prominent horses don't commit early
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the pace-setters to conserve energy and they can sustain their effort to the line. Front runners and prominent racers will dominate the finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Meltdown
scenarios.trigger: If Sodeto stops badly and all prominent horses struggle with the testing conditions simultaneously
scenarios.body: The race becomes a survival test where any horse finishing strongly will win regardless of ability. The most patient rides on the freshest horses will prevail.

races.paceDynamic: Station X will take the field along as the only confirmed front runner, likely joined by prominent runners Parisiac, The Bell Conductor, Hundred Caps and Vince L'Amour in the early positions. With just one true pace-setter over 5f on soft ground, Station X should get comfortable sectionals without pressure, creating a sustainable tempo that won't expose stamina limitations. The large contingent of hold-up horses (Trilby, Francisco's Piece, Spoof, Peter The Wolf, Arctic Summer, Qila) will be relying on the pace coming back to them in testing conditions. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can secure good positions early and kick from the soft ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Station X Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Station X gets uncontested lead and dictates fractions
scenarios.body: The front runner uses the testing conditions to his advantage and proves hard to peg back, with prominent runners best placed to challenge. Hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on the energy-sapping surface.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack apply early pressure to Station X
scenarios.body: The pace quickens through the middle stages, setting up a sprint finish where class tells and the best horses on soft ground come through. Fresh legs from the pace-pressing group prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Swoop
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves too slow on the testing ground
scenarios.body: The hold-up brigade get the perfect setup as the race becomes a dash from 2f out, allowing proven soft ground performers to unleash their finishing kicks. Class rises to the surface in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Station X fails to handle the conditions or gets headed early
scenarios.body: Multiple horses compete for the lead creating a messy pace, with the race falling apart in the final stages. An outsider who stayed out of trouble benefits from the chaos.

races.paceDynamic: West Tyrone and V Twelve are the confirmed front runners who will contest the early lead, ensuring an honest gallop from the start. With Jaminoz, Taylormade Lad, and Letmeseethecolts also showing prominent tendencies, the pace should be solid throughout this 1m3f test on soft ground. The combination of two keen leaders and several prominent runners will create a searching gallop that should suit the hold-up horses perfectly. This race shape strongly favours horses with hold-up running styles who can finish strongly off the honest pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If West Tyrone and V Twelve engage in an early battle while the prominent runners press on
scenarios.body: The honest pace will stretch the field and tire the early leaders, allowing the hold-up brigade to sweep past in the final furlong. Horses like Naturalia, Golspie, and Dr Rio can time their runs perfectly off this searching gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Jaminoz or Taylormade Lad can secure ideal positions just behind the leaders without getting embroiled in early pace battles
scenarios.body: They can kick clear before the hold-up horses get organized, using their soft ground credentials to maintain the advantage. Jaminoz's course-and-distance win and Taylormade Lad's recent form make them the most likely prominent winners.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both West Tyrone and V Twelve fail to show their usual early speed after lengthy absences
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical crawl that favours horses with a turn of foot rather than pure stamina. This would particularly benefit any horse capable of quickening from midfield positions in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If West Tyrone gets an uncontested lead with V Twelve failing to fire after 62 days off
scenarios.body: He can dictate terms and prove too strong for the field, particularly given his 1m2f stamina credentials. The soft ground and extended trip could play to his staying power if allowed an easy time up front.

watchPoints.text: West Tyrone and V Twelve must both show their usual early speed or the entire pace scenario collapses into a tactical affair

races.paceDynamic: Unchartedterritory is the only confirmed front runner in a field dominated by hold-up horses and prominent racers, meaning he can dictate terms without pressure through the early stages. The prominent racers Lightening Lad, Attention Seeker and Espanita will track him in second gear, while the large contingent of hold-up horses including Hatamoto, Clocker, Ephron, Mr Moonshine, Cosmic Man, Scheffler and Ibn Altheeb will be anchored towards the rear. This sets up a tactical affair where the pace could be steady early before quickening, but the soft ground will make it harder for the back markers to make up ground in the closing stages. The race shape strongly favours prominent racers and the lone front runner, as they can secure good positions without expending energy and kick clear before the hold-up horses can respond.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Unchartedterritory gets an easy lead and the field allows him comfortable sectionals
scenarios.body: He can dictate the race from pillar to post and prove hard to peg back on testing ground. The hold-up horses will struggle to make up the deficit in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent racers position perfectly behind Unchartedterritory and time their challenge
scenarios.body: They benefit from ideal pace positioning while avoiding the energy-sapping chase from the rear that the hold-up horses face. The soft ground aids their sustained gallop over the closing stages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Hold-Up Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong and the front runners tire dramatically
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses can sweep up from the rear as the leaders capitulate on the testing surface. However, they need significant pace collapse to overcome their positional disadvantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Messy Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Unchartedterritory goes too slowly early and bunches the field for a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with traffic problems likely given the number of hold-up horses converging late. The soft ground could still favour those who conserved energy best.
